content:
Elbe River flows—  
Baroque spires rise, then ash fell.  
Phoenix blooms anew.  

*(This haiku honors Dresden’s beauty, its tragic destruction in WWII, and its resilient rebirth—adhering to the 5-7-5 syllable structure.)*
